Source: Current estimates show that there are approximately 6000 - 8000 rare Diseases (RDs) which affect over 300 million people worldwide.
Luganda: Emiwendo egiriwo giraga nti waliwo obulwadde 6000 - 8000 obutalabikalabika (RDs) obukosa abantu abasukka mu bukadde 300 okwetooloola ensi.
Yoruba: Ìṣirò tí wọ́n ṣe láìpẹ́ fi hàn pé àwọn àrùn tó ṣọ̀wọ́n (RDs) to 6000-8000 tí ó máa ń mú àwọn ènìyàn tí wọ́n ju mílíọ̀nù 300 lọ kárí ayé.
Zulu: Izilinganiso zamanje zibonisa ukuthi cishe ziyi-6000 - 8000 Izifo ezingavamile (RDs) ezithinta abantu abangaphezu kwezigidi ezinga-300 emhlabeni jikelele.
Hausa: Ƙiyasai na yanzu sun nuna cewa akwai kusan cututtuka guda 6000 da 8000 nadirai (RDs) waɗanda suke shafar sama da mutane miliyan 300 a duk duniya.
Northern Sotho: Dikakanyo tša bjale di bontšha gore go na le Malwetši a go hlaga ka sewelo (di-RD) ao a ka balelwago go a 6000 - 8000 ao a amago dimilione tše 300 tša batho lefaseng ka bophara.
Amharic: በግምት በአለም ዙሪያ ከ300 ሚሊየን በላይ ሰዎች ላይ ተጽእኖ የሚያደርጉ ከ6000-8000 የሚደርሱ ያልተለመዱ በሽታዎች (ያ.በ) እንዳሉ ወቅታዊ ግምቶች  ያሳያሉ፡፡

Source: Individually, each RD affects <200,000 people mainly children because of limited survival, leaving a lifetime/life changing impact on affected individuals.
Luganda: Buli RD, kinneemu, ekosa abantu <200,000 okusingira ddala abaana olw’okuba ng’ababuwona batono, ne zirekera abakoseddwa obuzibu bwe balwa nabwo ekiseera ekinene.
Yoruba: Lọ́tọ́ọ̀tọ̀, RD kọ̀ọ̀kan máa ń mú àwọn <200,000 ènìyàn àgàgà àwọn ọmọdé nítorí ìwọ̀nba ni bí wọ́n ṣe le la nǹkan kọjá sí, tí ó sì ń fi ipa sílẹ̀ lórí ìgbésí ayé/ìyípadà ìgbé ayé fún àwọn tí ó bá mú.
Zulu: Ngayinye, i-RD ngayinye ithinta <abantu abanga-200,000 ikakhulukazi izingane ngenxa yokuphila okukhawulekile, okushiya umthelela oshintsha impilo/ukuphila kubantu abathintekile.
Hausa: Kowannensu, kowane RD yana shafar mutane <200,000 galibi yara saboda iyakancewar rayuwa, yana barin tasirin rayuwa ko canza rayuwa a kan mutanen da abin ya shafa.
Northern Sotho: E le noši, RD ye nngwe le ye nngwe e ama <batho ba 200,000 e lego bana ka bontši ka gore sebaka sa go phologo ke se sennyane, ya tlogela kamego ya bophelo ka moka/ye e fetošago bophelo go batho bao ba amegago.
Amharic: በግል፣ እያንዳንዱ ያ.በ <200 000 ሰዎችን፣ በዋነኝነት ልጆችን በተገደበ የመትረፍ መጠን ምክንያት የሚጎዳ ሲሆን፣ የህይወት ዘመን/ህይወትን የሚቀይር ተጽእኖ በተጠቁ ግለሰቦች ላይ ያደርሳል፡፡

Source: Most RDs have a genetic origin, however the underlying causes and mechanisms of RDs are still largely unknown.
Luganda: Endwadde za RD ezisinga ziba za buzaale, wabula ebizireeta n’ensaasaana yaazo tebinnaba kumanyibwa bulungi.
Yoruba: Púpọ̀ lára àwọn RD máa ń ní orísun tí ó jẹ mọ́ jíìnì, síbẹ̀ síbẹ̀ ìdí gan pàtó àti ìgbésẹ̀ RD ṣì jẹ́ ohun tí àwọn ènìyàn ò tíì mọ̀.
Zulu: Ama-RD amaningi anemvelaphi yofuzo, nokho-ke izimbangela nezindlela zama-RD azikaziwa kakhulu.
Hausa: Yawancin RDs suna da asalin ƙwayoyin gado, duk da haka, ba a san ainihin musabbabin da kuma hanyoyin RDs ba.
Northern Sotho: Bontši bja malwetši a go hlaga ka sewelo (di-RD) bo bakwa ke leabela, eupša mabaka le ditsela tšeo di-RD di hlolegago ka gona ga di tsebje le gabjale.

Source: In Tanzania, there is limited data on incidence, distribution and types of RDs.

Source: In addition, there is little awareness and understanding of RDs by the public, which has resulted in poor management and stigmatization of individuals with RDs.
Luganda: Ekirala, waliwo okumanya kutono ku RD mu bantu ba bulijjo, ekiviiriddeko okukwatibwa obubi n’okusosola abantu abazirina.
Yoruba: Ní àfikún, ìmọ̀ àti òye díẹ̀ ni àwọn ènìyàn ní nípa RD ní èyí tó já sí ìṣàkóso tí kò dára tó àti fífi àbùkù kan àwọn tí wọ́n ní RD.
Zulu: Ukwengeza, kukhona ukuqwashiseka nokuqonda okuncane komphakathi ngama-RD, okubangele ukuphathwa kabi nokucwaswa kwabantu abane-RD.

Source: To address this problem, a RD day is commemorated globally every February with the aim of raising awareness among the general public and decision makers about RDs and their impacts on individuals’ lives.
Luganda: Okuvvuunuka ekizibu kino, olunaku lw’endwadde za RD lukuzibwa mu nsi yonna mu Gwakubiri n’ekigendererwa ky’okwongera okumanyisa abantu ba bulijjo n’abakulembeze ku ndwadde ezitalabikalabika ne bye zituusa ku bulamu bw’abantu.
Yoruba: Láti wá ìyànjú sí ìṣòro yìí, wọ́n máa ń ṣe àyájọ́ ọjọ́ RD ní gbogbo oṣù February láti fi ìmọ̀ rẹ yé àwọn ènìyàn àwùjọ àti àwọn tí wọ́n ń dá pinu nípa RD àti ipa wọn lórí ayé àwọn ènìyàn.
